gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all screen schemes to understand how screens are organized in the Jira projects.
gold.ideal: The response should return a list of all screen schemes with their IDs, names, and descriptions.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new screen scheme to customize the issue view for my team.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the creation of the screen scheme and return the new screen scheme ID and details.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to delete an obsolete screen scheme to keep the system organized.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the successful deletion of the screen scheme.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to update an existing screen scheme to reflect changes in our project workflow.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the update and return the updated screen scheme details.
